about: Corrections to the LiveAzan research directory that make-directory.py applies on every run, so refreshing the source does not bring the mistakes back. 'website' puts the right address in; 'clear' leaves the masjid on the map with no website, so it can borrow a neighbour's times; 'remove' drops something that is not a masjid. A rule applies only while the research still holds the website in 'was'. Found by packaging/audit-directory-websites.py.

overrides.name: Islamic Information Centre of Calgary
overrides.why: The domain is for sale (HugeDomains). No centre of this name turned up at 1207 11 Ave SW; the live Islamic Information Society of Calgary (iisc.ca) is a different body.

overrides.name: MAC Edmonton Islamic Centre
overrides.why: macnet.ca/local/edmonton now lands on a 2022 news article. MAC's page for its Edmonton centre (Rahma Mosque, 6104 172 St NW) is on centres.macnet.ca.

overrides.name: Masjid Al-Salaam
overrides.why: masjidalsalaam.ca is Masjid Al-Salaam in Edmonton. The Burnaby one is the BC Muslim Association's Burnaby branch (5060 Canada Way), whose page is headed 'Masjid Al-Salaam & Education Center'.

overrides.name: Grand Mosque of Winnipeg
overrides.why: winnipegmosque.com is a professor's personal site. The Grand Mosque (2445 Waverley St) is run by the Manitoba Islamic Association, which has a page for it.

overrides.name: Alliston Masjid (Muslims of Alliston Centre)
overrides.why: The domain no longer exists and no other site was found.

overrides.name: Windsor Islamic Association Educational & Community Centre (Amherstburg)
overrides.why: Filed with the association's front page, which shows the Windsor mosque's times. This is a different site (5791 N Townline Rd), described on the association's own page as a school campus with no prayer hall.

overrides.name: Brampton Makki Masjid
overrides.why: makkimasjid.com is Makki Masjid in Chicago (3418 W Ainslie St). The Brampton masjid, of the Islamic Society of Peel, is on makkimasjid.ca.

overrides.name: Jamiat-Ul-Ansar of Brampton
overrides.why: www.jamiatulansar.ca does not resolve; the bare domain redirects to jamiatalansar.ca, the masjid's own site.

overrides.name: Al-Aqsa Mosque
overrides.why: The domain no longer exists. The only website OpenStreetMap holds for it is a business-directory listing, not the masjid's.

overrides.name: Hamilton Mountain Masjid
overrides.why: hamiltonmosque.com redirects to the front page of the Muslim Association of Hamilton, which runs three mosques. This one, at 1545 Stone Church Rd E, has its own page.

overrides.name: Hamilton Mountain Mosque (Ibrahim Jame Masjid)
overrides.why: The domain no longer exists. Same address (1545 Stone Church Rd E) as Hamilton Mountain Masjid, whose page this is.

overrides.name: Muslim Association of Hamilton
overrides.why: The domain no longer exists. The association's site (mahcanada.com) covers three mosques, and this entry's address (1165 Upper James St) is not one of them; Hamilton Mountain Mosque carries the association's page.

overrides.name: Al Falah Islamic Centre (Kitchener)
overrides.why: The hosting account is suspended. MAWAQIT lists an Al-Falah Centre in Kitchener 2.6 km from this entry's coordinates with no address, so it cannot be confirmed as the same place.

overrides.name: MAC London Islamic Centre (Westmount Center)
overrides.why: macnet.ca/local/london now lands on a 2020 newspaper op-ed. The centre named is Westmount Masjid (312 Commissioners Rd W), which has a page on centres.macnet.ca. The research address (649 Wilkins St) disagrees with the name.

overrides.name: Imam Bukhari Centre
overrides.why: The front page of the national Ahle-Hadith Society says 'please select your centre'. The page for this centre (50 Steeles Ave E, Milton) is /toronto/, which names Imam Bukhari Centre.

overrides.name: Anatolia Islamic Centre
overrides.why: The domain no longer exists; the centre is on anatoliacentre.ca.

overrides.name: Masjid Dar Al-Tawheed
overrides.why: The .com no longer exists; the centre is on daraltawheed.ca.

overrides.name: Muslim World League
overrides.why: The domain redirects to a casino-spam site. The listing is an NGO office rather than a congregation, and its address (2630 Royal Windsor Dr) is doubtful; left in place for a person to decide.

overrides.name: Sayeda Khadija Centre
overrides.why: The domain no longer exists. The Sayeda Khadija Centre is at 7150 Edwards Blvd (two other entries, on sayedakhadijacentre.com); 6120 Montevideo Rd, where this entry is, is the Ar-Rehman Islamic Centre.

overrides.name: Pembroke Islamic Centre
overrides.why: The domain no longer exists and no other site was found.

overrides.name: Imam Mahdi Islamic Centre
overrides.why: imic.ca is now a domain-for-sale page. The centre (7340 Bayview Ave) is on imammahdi.ca, which its other entry (Markham) already uses.

overrides.name: Ja'ffari Islamic Centre
overrides.why: The domain no longer exists; the centre's page is on jaffari.org.

overrides.name: Abu Huraira Centre
overrides.why: The domain no longer exists; the centre is on abuhuraira.org. This entry's address and coordinates (100 McLevin Ave, Scarborough) do not match the centre's (270 Yorkland Blvd).

overrides.name: Islamic Institute of Toronto
overrides.why: iit.org is the alumni site of the Indian Institute of Technology. The Islamic Institute of Toronto (1630 Neilson Rd) is on islam.ca.

overrides.name: Ismaili Centre Toronto
overrides.why: Redirects to the.ismaili, the global Ismaili community site, which is drawn by script and has no page a program can read for this centre. A jamatkhana that publishes no daily times.

overrides.name: Muslim Welfare Center
overrides.why: The page serves nothing a program can read, and nothing places a masjid at this address (Muslim Welfare Canada's musalla is in Mississauga).

overrides.name: The Reign of Islamic Da'Wah (TROID)
overrides.why: tfreed.org no longer exists. TROID's own site is troid.org, which runs Masjid al-Furqan at 874 Weston Rd. It turns programs away (403), so the page itself could not be read.

overrides.name: Baitul Islam Mosque
overrides.why: Filed with the front page of the Ahmadiyya community's national site, not the mosque's page.

overrides.name: Muslim Association of Canada (MAC) Waterloo
overrides.why: macnet.ca/local/waterloo now lands on a 2020 news article. MAC's Waterloo centres are the Islamic Centre of Waterloo (510 Erbsville Rd, already listed) and Kitchener Masjid; nothing of MAC's is at this entry's address, and its coordinates are on Waterloo Masjid, which is not MAC's.

overrides.name: Baitul Ehsaan Mosque
overrides.why: 404: the page is spelt baitul-ehsan and lives under /mosque/.

overrides.name: Dominion Mosque
overrides.why: www.windsormosque.com fails its TLS handshake; the bare domain redirects to the Windsor Islamic Association, whose Windsor mosque this is (1320 Northwood St).

overrides.name: Windsor Islamic Association (Masjid Al-Hijrah)
overrides.why: The domain no longer exists. Same address and telephone as Dominion Mosque, the association's Windsor mosque, whose site this is.

overrides.name: Islamic Centre of Quebec
overrides.why: icquebec.org (which also fails its certificate) is now Les Incroyables Comestibles du Quebec, a food-sharing group. The centre's own site, titled Islamic Centre of Quebec, is icqmontreal.com.
